conflict_resolution_rule: Primary federal authority overrides carrier guidance.
outdated_guidance_rule: If a newer contract-year rule, CFR text, or CMS guidance exists, older guidance must be flagged and not treated as current controlling authority.
excerpt_rule: Store only minimal rule-relevant excerpts of 150 words or fewer.
citation_rule: Each source entry must include normalized publisher, URL, published_date when available, and date_accessed.
